notes.title: Preparatory Patch
notes.content: This is a small patch with a few typos, the introduction of a checkpoint system, and a few continuity tweaks in preparation for the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2767740/Werewolves_3_Evolutions_End/]Werewolves 3: Evolution's End[/url] next month.
